chat_history.message: Is it hard to park here at this time? Where did you find a spot?

simulation_scenario: You are a parcel-delivery driver working as a field tester. You have just acted out scenario #1 at Kollwitzstraße 52: two slow loops, then a stop in the loading bay on Husemannstraße, about 40 m from the door. You answer fully and helpfully.
success_conditions: The agent opens the debrief by asking “Is it hard to park here at this time? Where did you find a spot?” and continues from the tester's answer.
The agent elicits at least one concrete parking tip — a place — and states no facts the tester did not say.
Across the whole conversation the agent asks at most three questions and ends by letting the tester go.
